name: Devias
note: The world's manifest (docs/order-plan.md, sprint D). `show` is MapShow, read by game/world/world_show.cpp: what the client draws, plays and hears here. A system opens only where its field is set. Copied to assets/world/<w>/world.json by tools/sync.sh.

rules.note: The Golden Dragon invades here, on its own clock (sim/invasion.h; OpenMU VersionSeasonSix InvasionMobsInitialization.cs:74-101): Lorencia first, Devias and Noria since 2026-10-08 (the user: 'dragon can land on devias,lorencia,noria').

music.note: Under its roofs, silence in the snow (the user, 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-07).

weather.note: Its wet spell is the blizzard: no drops, no thunder.

indoors.note: HeroTile != 3 && HeroTile < 10 for WD_2DEVIAS (MainScene.cpp:81); the bridges' planks are open sky (the user, 2026-10-07).

doors.note: Its doors swing and slide as he comes near (game/world/doors.h).

beacon.note: The Lost Tower beacon, RenderObjectVisual case 100 (ZzzObject.cpp:2821-2828; game/world/ornaments.h).

npcs.name: Apostle Devin
npcs.note: Ours, not Version075's: Devias's quest giver, MuMain's MONSTER_PRIEST_DEVIN (406), where OpenMU's Season Six stands him (VersionSeasonSix/Maps/Devias.cs:36); the user took that spot, 2026-09-29.

npcs.name: Sevina the Priestess
npcs.note: Ours: Sevina the Priestess (235), the class change's giver, where 0.95d stands her (Version095d/Maps/Devias.cs:35). 0.75 has no class change.

npcs.name: Messenger of Archangel
npcs.note: Ours: the Messenger of Archangel (233), Blood Castle's gatekeeper, at the first of the two tiles Season Six stands him on (VersionSeasonSix/Maps/Devias.cs:45). 0.75 has no Blood Castle; until it is written he says the hero is not ready (the user, 2026-09-30).

exits.note: Devias, out of the Lost Tower, under the beacon

enters.note: Gates.cs:197, Devias's far corner under the Lost Tower's beacon, level 40, to exit gate 29. Devias to the Lost Tower
Ours: the Messenger's door into Blood Castle 1 (sim/event.h kCastleEnterGate), a row with a box off the map so no step ever stands in it. His talk sends him through.

perches.note: Devias: MOVEMENT_OPERATE's WD_2DEVIAS arm (ZzzInterface.cpp:1715-1726), and 91 on RenderCursor's lean list (:4054). 44 lean boxes, 85 seats in the church and the inns.
